title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA-1997 9.7.2 A look into the prosecutions, that were launched into the Tax evasion, reveals that conviction awarded was low for such prosecutions. During the year 1997, of the 184 cases which were prosecuted under Direct Taxes enactments, 38 cases were compounded, 135 cases were acquitted and only 11 cases resulted in convictions (See Annexure-XIII).
